description:
Check the health status of the AutoMem service and its connected databases (FalkorDB graph + Qdrant vectors).

**When to use:**
- Before a session to verify the memory service is available
- When memory operations are failing unexpectedly
- To check storage statistics

**Example:**
- check_database_health({})
name: check_database_health

error.description: Error message if status is error

statistics.description: Database statistics and diagnostics, including memory/vector counts, sync_status, vector_dimensions, and enrichment state when provided.

status.description: Overall health status. degraded means the service is reachable but a backend or sync check needs attention.

title: Check Database Health
